Name: Zinley
Tagline: Your Personal AI Representative for calls, email, and tasks
Description: Most AI waits inside a chat. Zinley is reachable by you and the people around you. With its own phone number and email, it answers calls, handles email, books things, and gets work done within your rules. It remembers your people and relationships, then reports back in your language. Not another chatbot. A second you that shows up.

Name: YourSitee
Tagline: Make your bio link worth clicking
Description: YourSitee turns your scattered online presence into one visual page that feels like you, not another list of buttons. Build with 20+ widgets, import your Linktree with AI, and see what people click with built-in analytics. All your links. One place.

Name: Capptivo
Tagline: Free open-source screen recorder & demo editor
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Video
Description: Capptivo is a free, open-source screen recorder and demo editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Record locally, add follow-cursor zooms, polish the look, burn on-device captions, and export, no account, no subscription. Give your demos the spotlight they deserve.

Name: Lumichats(Free)
Tagline: A Claude Code alternative for people who avoid the terminal
Description: 70,000 people use LumiChats in a browser and kept asking for the one thing a browser cannot do: touch their files. So we built the desktop one. It runs commands on your machine, writes real documents, and you pay only for the work you run.

Name: Termexo
Tagline: A local Windows workbench for Claude Code and Codex
Description: Termexo brings Claude Code and Codex into one recoverable Windows workspace. Arrange real PTY terminals in custom grids, search and resume native sessions, get notified when an agent needs approval, and switch Claude-compatible model profiles without rebuilding environment variables. Local-first, no Termexo account required.

Name: Finamie
Tagline: Speak your expenses and get instant spending insights
Description: Finamie turns your voice into detailed financial insights, automatically. Log expenses hands-free, track your spending, and understand your money like never before.

Name: Zen Whisper
Tagline: On-device Mac dictation that types into any app
Description: Hold a shortcut and dictate into any Mac app without sending audio to the cloud. Zen Whisper keeps core speech recognition on-device, with local models, searchable transcripts, voice memos, media transcription, and Pro tools for larger models and translation.

Name: Bolcho AI
Tagline: Build Voice AI agents that actually speak India
Description: Bolcho AI is an AI voice platform that helps businesses build, deploy and scale multilingual AI phone and web agents. Unlike generic Voice AI platforms, Bolcho is built for India—with native language support, ultra-low latency, telephony integrations, and the flexibility to bring your own LLMs, STT, and TTS providers. From sales and support to appointment booking and customer engagement, launch production-ready voice agents in minutes.

Name: UniwebPay Skill
Tagline: Financial Infra for the AI era
Description: Accept payments the moment you ship. UniwebPay Skill is the financial infrastructure for the AI era, helping builders turn AI products into businesses. Generate payment links, accept global payment methods, and start getting paid without the usual payment setup, merchant onboarding, or infrastructure overhead.

Name: FreqWave EQ
Tagline: Customize your web audio with a real-time EQ
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Music, GitHub, Edge Extensions
Description: 8-band Web Audio Equalizer - fixing muddy podcasts, harsh streams and quiet dialogue. Featuring EQ modes and DSP Compression.

Name: TextMyPill
Tagline: WhatsApp medicine reminders. No app needed. 🦦
Description: Set medicine reminders for yourself or your entire family from one dashboard — anywhere in the world. Pillo delivers reminders on WhatsApp automatically. Snap a prescription, AI reads it, done. Track who took what. No app needed. Free 7-day trial.

Name: InvoProof
Tagline: Invoice-verified reviews for freelancers
Description: InvoProof turns every paid invoice into a verified case study on your public portfolio. Send a professional invoice, get paid, and the client's review — provably tied to that real payment — becomes proof on your profile automatically. No chasing testimonials, no fake reviews, no blank portfolio pages. Free for up to 3 projects.

Name: PraiseEngine
Tagline: Turn customer conversations into SEO-ready social proof.
Description: PraiseEngine is an AI-native review platform that turns blank textareas into frictionless interviews. Using a 3-question adaptive AI Interview tailored to your business, it drafts grounded, accurate testimonials directly from your customer’s words. Teams moderate every entry before publishing via one-line website embeds or indexable SEO review profiles with JSON-LD schema. Built for solopreneurs, SaaS scaleups, and agencies needing automated trust generation without auto-publish risk.

Name: VibeCodersLegal
Tagline: Find what regulators would fine — before they do
Description: Compliance audits and fixes for products built on Lovable, Bolt, v0, and Cursor. AI-powered, lawyer-reviewed, shipped in days. GDPR, AI Act, CCPA — without lawyers. Scan your site for GDPR gaps. No signup, no email gate.

Name: Taffy
Tagline: Sort, don't budget
Description: Spending awareness without the homework. Connect your bank, tap each transaction into a bucket, and see where your money went. No budget required.

Name: GrowthRail
Tagline: Add referrals in an afternoon, free to start.
Description: GrowthRail is a developer-first referral platform to launch and manage native referral programs. Integrates via drop-in SDKs & referral APIs for SaaS, web, and mobile apps.

Name: StoryVoice
Tagline: Customer case studies from 5-minute voice interviews
Description: Send a link, your customer talks for 5 minutes, and AI generates a publish-ready case study with real quotes and metrics. No writer. No follow-ups.

Name: LTH Shield
Tagline: Linux hardening & IPS for VPS — without the enterprise bill
Description: LTH Shield is affordable Linux hardening + monitoring for small teams—not enterprise EDR. One install command on Ubuntu/Debian gives fail2ban, FIM, baselines, and optional Snort AI IPS (learning/rules on our servers, controlled in the portal). Built for the wave of vibe-coded apps and founders spinning up VPS boxes who need real protection without Falcon/Darktrace pricing or a SOC.

Name: Paste Drops
Tagline: Cyclops calms your angry texts and roasts you a little
Description: Paste (or speak) the message you're about to regret, and Cyclops, a one-eyed desk mascot, hands back a version that won't get you blocked or fired. He roasts you a bit for how heated you got, then reads the calm version aloud in the accent of your choice (Irish, Aussie, Scottish, British, American), in virtually any language. Pick your bite: sensible, petty, or talk-me-out. He steams, dozes, squeaks, and hides a few easter eggs. No account, no ads, nothing stored. Free.

Name: Tempest
Tagline: Run AI agents in parallel with 64% fewer tokens
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: You run multiple AI coding agents, but they all waste tokens understanding the same repository. Tempest fixes this. Index your repository once, then run every agent in its own isolated workspace while sharing the same understanding. Up to 64% fewer tokens for any agent.
